Input for the piercing verifier.
Coefficients b_ij of W_14 = sum b_ij B_i^14((2x-1)^2) B_j^14((2y-1)^2), for 0<=i<=j<=14.
Row i lists b_ii, b_i(i+1), ..., b_i14, as numerators over bDen. The verifier sets b_ji = b_ij.
Text outside the [key]...[/key] [value]...[/value] records is ignored.
